test_title: PYST 190: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 14th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

bi_h_h_is_ohb_sh_h
solution:
Given sequence: bi_h_h_is_ohb_sh_h

 
• sobhio → bi**s**h**o**h - **b**is**h**oh - b**i**sh**o**h
 
• sohboi → bi**s**h**o**h - **h**is**b**oh - bo&l
